summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which auto-fires on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads a pinned Bun runtime release from GitHub, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB single-line bundle in the package tarball that uses string-array rotation obfuscation (WV8StW/n7gIxM), hex numeric literals, and mangled identifiers. The obfuscated bundle is not referenced from index.js and has no documented purpose; it is only reachable through the preinstall-driven Bun execution. Using a freshly-downloaded alternate language runtime to execute an opaque bundled payload at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, chosen to bypass Node-based review of what runs. Package metadata is placeholder-grade (empty description, empty author, no repository, generic name), consistent with a disposable distribution vehicle rather than a legitimate library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
